sources.title: AI Agent Standards Initiative
sources.summary: NIST initiative for interoperable and secure agent adoption, including agent authentication, identity infrastructure and security evaluations.
sources.implication: Maintain explicit agent identity, delegated authority, revocation and interoperable evidence.

sources.title: Identity and Authority of Software Agents
sources.summary: Agent access to data, tools and applications requires appropriate identification and authorization controls.
sources.implication: Every Office agent and connector requires an accountable principal and bounded authority envelope.

sources.title: Challenges to the Monitoring of Deployed AI Systems
sources.summary: Post-deployment monitoring is organized across functionality, operations, human factors, security, compliance and large-scale impacts.
sources.implication: The Office monitoring constitution must cover all six domains and combine automated and human-validated monitoring.

sources.title: Transparency obligations under Article 50 of the AI Act
sources.summary: Relevant transparency obligations apply from 2 August 2026, including notices for direct AI interaction and marking of certain generated content.
sources.implication: Persistently label algorithmic outputs and preserve machine-readable provenance and human-review status.

sources.title: PROV-O: The PROV Ontology
sources.summary: W3C Recommendation for representing and interchanging provenance across systems and contexts.
sources.implication: Evidence Dockets and Chronicle records should use explicit entity, activity, agent and derivation relations.

sources.title: OWASP GenAI Security Project
sources.summary: Open security guidance for generative and agentic AI systems, including excessive agency and untrusted tool output risks.
sources.implication: Use least privilege, transaction gates, output validation, sandboxing and evidence before external execution.

sources.title: Langue du commerce et des affaires
sources.summary: Businesses operating in Quebec must provide a complete French version of commercial websites.
sources.implication: Maintain complete, equal-quality French and English operating interfaces, with French fully available.

sources.title: Responsibility for Personal Information Protection
sources.authority: Commission d’accès à l’information du Québec
sources.summary: Private organizations remain responsible for the personal information they collect, use, disclose and retain; the highest authority is the default privacy officer unless delegated.
sources.implication: Publish privacy-officer details, maintain data maps, retention rules, access rights, incident response and PIAs for protected deployments.

sources.title: Energy and AI
sources.summary: Data-centre electricity demand is projected to more than double by 2030, with AI the principal driver.
sources.implication: Productive-capacity scenarios must jointly model compute, power, grid, location, timing and infrastructure constraints.

sources.title: The next evolution of the Agents SDK
sources.summary: Agent harnesses increasingly support controlled sandboxes, durable execution and separation of harness state from compute.
sources.implication: Protected runtimes should isolate execution, externalize durable state and keep credentials outside model-generated code environments.
